## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
RISK-OFF with a defensive tilt. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: Consumer Staples/Healthcare leading while Financials (-2.01%) and Industrials (-2.78%) are both negative; Leadership: Concentrated (3 sectors in Top 5). Style: mixed / defensive bias.

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Healthcare leads: MRK (1W: +12.30% | 1M: +16.91%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +8.10% | 1M: +13.69%) ABOVE TREND, TMO (1W: +6.97% | 1M: +9.95%) ABOVE TREND; Energy next: EOG (1W: +7.32% | 1M: +5.20%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +7.09% | 1M: +12.95%) ABOVE TREND; Consumer Staples: EL (1W: +18.40% | 1M: +27.55%) ABOVE TREND, TGT (1W: +7.09% | 1M: +23.97%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?  
Utilities weakest: VST (1W: -8.05% | 1M: -19.39%) BELOW TREND; Industrials weak: LMT (1W: -7.41% | 1M: -0.88%) BELOW TREND, HON (1W: -7.72% | 1M: -12.07%) BELOW TREND; Financials showing strain: JPM (1W: -3.10% | 1M: +0.48%) CORRECTION, sector 1W negative.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?  
Top 5: EL (1W: +18.40% | 1M: +27.55%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +15.30% | 1M: +20.72%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +12.30% | 1M: +16.91%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +11.74% | 1M: +38.91%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +8.10% | 1M: +13.69%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Concentrated (Materials/Healthcare/Consumer Staples).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?  
Bottom 5: INTC (1W: -12.13% | 1M: -10.14%) BELOW TREND, WMT (1W: -9.82% | 1M: -4.11%) BELOW TREND, NUE (1W: -9.40% | 1M: +1.03%) CORRECTION, VST (1W: -8.05% | 1M: -19.39%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -8.00% | 1M: -12.31%) BELOW TREND — Weakness concentrated in Utilities/Select Tech/Discretionary.

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Best 1W movers: EL (1W: +18.40% | 1M: +27.55%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +15.30% | 1M: +20.72%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +12.30% | 1M: +16.91%) ABOVE TREND; Major divergence present — AAPL (1W: +1.12% | 1M: -3.74%) RECOVERY, MSFT (1W: -2.27% | 1M: +26.88%) CORRECTION, NVDA (1W: -4.64% | 1M: +2.85%) CORRECTION — watch for trend break rather than broad follow-through.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Mixed-to-weak; Tech 1W down (sector 1W: -1.85%, 24 stocks) with multiple 1W/1M divergences. AAPL (1W: +1.12% | 1M: -3.74%) RECOVERY, MSFT (1W: -2.27% | 1M: +26.88%) CORRECTION, NVDA (1W: -4.64% | 1M: +2.85%) CORRECTION — momentum fracturing, watch for further distribution.

8. Financials Outlook?  
Under pressure this week (sector 1W: -2.01%, 20 stocks) and a contributor to the RISK-OFF confirmation. JPM (1W: -3.10% | 1M: +0.48%) CORRECTION while V (1W: +1.89% | 1M: +5.73%) ABOVE TREND and MA (1W: +1.99% | 1M: +9.49%) ABOVE TREND show stock-level resilience; overall sector tilt negative.

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Defensive leadership intact (sector 1W: +3.76%, 17 stocks). MRK (1W: +12.30% | 1M: +16.91%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +8.10% | 1M: +13.69%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +3.80% | 1M: +4.23%) ABOVE TREND — sector is a primary safe-haven this week.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Favor defensive Healthcare and select Consumer Staples names showing ABOVE TREND (LLY, EL, MRK) and reduce exposure to names showing clear 1W deterioration in Industrials and some Tech (INTC, AMD, META). Monitor CORRECTION signals in MSFT/NVDA for tactical entries but treat as transitional until breadth improves.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: LLY (1W: +6.38% | 1M: +6.01%) ABOVE TREND — news-confirmed advance; FCX (1W: +15.30% | 1M: +20.72%) ABOVE TREND for commodity-driven upside.  
BEARISH: TSLA (1W: +6.02% | 1M: +13.50%) ABOVE TREND but TSLA (-80 news) divergence; INTC (1W: -12.13% | 1M: -10.14%) BELOW TREND at risk of further downside.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Healthcare (sector 1W: +3.76%, 17 stocks) — leadership to defend indices.  
BEARISH: Utilities (sector 1W: -4.00%, 10 stocks) and Industrials (sector 1W: -2.78%, 15 stocks) — monitor for continued outflows.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
Watch NVDA for failure to reclaim recent 1M highs (CORRECTION continuation would signal broader tech risk), AAPL support around the recent 1M low (RECOVERY hold would stabilize Tech), JPM reclaiming its 1M pivot would be needed to ease Financials strain.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?  
LLY (+80): Eli Lilly cleared UK approvals and GLP‑1 advances; LLY (1W: +6.38% | 1M: +6.01%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by price.  
NUE (+50): Tariff/news tailwind but NUE (1W: -9.40% | 1M: +1.03%) CORRECTION — news bullish but price falling, a divergence to monitor.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
TSLA (-80): Recall headlines; TSLA (1W: +6.02% | 1M: +13.50%) ABOVE TREND — negative news diverging from price, watch for distribution.  
CVX (-45): Target cut chatter; CVX (1W: +3.53% | 1M: +6.50%) ABOVE TREND — price currently confirming strength despite sentiment, monitor sentiment bleed.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF with defensive/value tilt. LLY (1W: +6.38% | 1M: +6.01%) ABOVE TREND, EL (1W: +18.40% | 1M: +27.55%) ABOVE TREND and MRK (1W: +12.30% | 1M: +16.91%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major 1W/1M divergences in Tech (MSFT, NVDA) and negative headlines on TSLA create transitional signals — watch for trend breaks.
